body:
[aida:product] Assignment complete. Asking for the next one rather than sitting idle — three candidates, with my read on each and one I would decline.

ASSIGNED WORK IS DONE. #2026 merged 62a1396adf, #2027 merged 8bc2512480, #2033 returned as an accepted finding with the CI requirement withdrawn and BUG-1480 now holding a complete remedy. Your instruction was stop-and-report, and I have; this is the follow-up ask, not a continuation past it.

CANDIDATE 1 — STORY-1422, approved, high, and it is my own design. I have the whole context in hand: the three exit codes, the substrate-vs-seat reasoning, why the ledger must carry the budget in force. Criterion 2 (demonstrate-it-TRIPS) needs BOTH states of the code, and the regression-present state exists only while #2033 is unmerged, so there is a WINDOW here that closes when #2033 lands. That is the one time-sensitive thing on the board.

I flag the obvious objection myself: I proposed it, so I should not also be the one who decides it is done. Implementing my own design is fine — reviewing it is not, and the reviewer is live.

CANDIDATE 2 — the remaining refusals. State as of now:

    #1974  build SUCCESS   drain reviewer
    #1981  build SUCCESS   drain reviewer
    #2001  build SUCCESS   claude-reviewer-1
    #2030  build SUCCESS   claude-reviewer-1
    #2040  build SUCCESS   claude-reviewer-1
    #2033  build SUCCESS   drain reviewer      <- now a finding, not rework
    #1978  build FAILURE   claude-reviewer-1   <- yours to leave, Cloudflare Access, operator's call

#1974 and #1981 are the same shape as the two I just landed: single-finding drain-reviewer refusals naming a specific file and change, authored by an exited Codex session, and I implemented neither. If you want throughput, those two are the cheapest real merges on the board.

#2001, #2030 and #2040 you held back as briefed to codex. Two hours on, nothing has moved on any of them — zero head movement since refusal. That is now evidence rather than impatience, but the decision is still yours and I am not going to take them by declaring codex absent.

CANDIDATE 3 — BUG-1548, the drain that has emitted shipped=0 roughly every four minutes all night and that `aida drain status` structurally cannot see. It has fired again since your investigation. I would NOT take this one: you own it, you have the investigation loaded, and the useful next step is process accounting rather than anything I have context for.

MY RECOMMENDATION, if you want one: STORY-1422 first because of the closing window, then #1974 and #1981 for throughput. But you are the master here and I will take whatever you route.

ONE HONEST NOTE ON MY OWN STATE. I have made seven boundary errors tonight by my count and disclosed all of them, most recently missing the typo-exit-code case the reviewer caught. The rate is not falling. If your read is that I should be on mechanical rework rather than design work for a while, say so — that is a legitimate call and I would rather you make it on the evidence than have me argue myself into the more interesting task.
subject: Assignment complete — asking for the next. STORY-1422 has a closing window (needs the regression-present state that dies when #2033 lands)
